about: Scenarios for the Simulate a miss section. Each log is a section 6.11 event log. source 'live' shows 'Replay of a live run'; source 'sample' shows 'Sample data, will be replaced by a live run'. 'call' picks which search call in the log to replay (1-based); omit it to use the first call with a rescue. 'ghost' is the single-engine log for the same question and 'baseline' the Telem default log. Add 'ghost_grade': 'wrong' or 'correct' only when a judge graded that answer.
